body.statement: Let \(q_{\mathrm{bin}}=2\). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},1}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\), whose assumptions are exactly the Lee--Gu measurement graph, Markov factorization, positive latent support, binary measurement nondegeneracy, and binary double triangularity, both \((M_{\mathrm{bin}})_1\) and \((M_{\mathrm{bin}})_2\) are nonsingular, \(\operatorname{rank}((T_{12})_{\mathrm{bin}})=2^K\), and \((K_{\min})_{\mathrm{bin}}((P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}})=K\), which are the full-rank and latent-dimension conclusions of Lee and Gu (2026, Theorem 1). On \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{LG},2}^{\mathrm{bin}}(K,J)\), adding exactly their faithfulness, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions identifies \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{bin}}((P_X)_{\mathrm{bin}})\) modulo binary coordinate and state relabeling and the latent MEC, which is their Theorem 2 conclusion.
body.justification: The separately typed comparator records the exact binary assumptions and conclusions without specializing any categorical-domain symbol.
body.gap: This is a fidelity and reduction proposition, not a categorical novelty claim; all novel determinant and alignment theorems remain scoped to the declared categorical domain.
body.consumer: A unified checker can dispatch binary inputs to the published Lee--Gu certificate and categorical inputs to the local-minor certificate.
